name: Vampire - Regeneration - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: With a sickening ripple, its wounds knit together like silk, restored by the cursed embrace of eternal night.
The vampire’s flesh solidifies with an eerie, wet sound as dark energy mends its battered form.
Life returns to its veins in a rush, the taste of iron sharp on its tongue.
A pulse of unnatural vitality courses through its body, sealing every gash and bruise.
The shadows themselves seem to stitch his wounds shut as regeneration surges within.
